acceptanceCriteria: With a run receipt carrying request method and step, the write-response rule uses it and cites the receipt; without one it keeps the static reading.
Each of the three rules is reachable through the MCP surface or preflight, or the gap is recorded with a NOT_PRODUCED reason in the spec.
A response binding reassigned before its assertion is not credited to the wait.
A nested test.step is analysed as its own step.
body: Residuals of V1-1933/1934/1935 (PR #1206, head ecf300fa8; GH #1194/#1195/#1196): (1) the write-response rule (V1-1933) reads source only; it does not use recorded network evidence (request method, test step) from run receipts; (2) none of the three rules (write-response, seed collisions, revision-pinned citations) has an MCP tool or preflight surface; (3) a response binding reassigned before its assertion is still credited to the wait; (4) a nested test.step is read as part of the outer step. (3) and (4) are recorded failure modes in the build log 2026-10-19-V1-1933-1935-1934-write-response-seeds-citations.md.
title: Write-response, seed-collision and citation rules: recorded network evidence, MCP/preflight surface, reassigned bindings and nested steps
